Form No. 3
G. 25,000-1-34

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. REGISTRY. 5852 Date 1 / 19 34）
Date... May 1, 1934.

Subject (in full) N. Sokoloff-Andreeff, Soviet Employee.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [签名]

N. Sokoloff-Andreeff, 46, employee of the local office
of centrosojus, left Shanghai for Vladivostok by the s.s.
"Komiles" on April 13, 1934, accompanied by his wife, daughter
and one A. A. Golubeff, an employee of the local office of the
U.S.S.R. Sokoloff was formerly employed with The Shanghai
Oil Distributors. Mrs. Sokoloff is a Russian, 35 years of age,
and their daughter Tamara is 12 years of age.
Sokoloff resided from November 1, 1934 until March 7, 1934
at Flat 406 Embankment Building, No. 410 North Soochow Road.
Later, he removed to No. 37 Hwa Kee Avenue, No. 1025 Bubbling
Well Road.

[签名: g tcheremshansky]
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
